periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Distributed 210 naloxone kits and trained 60 residents in overdose response. Public Safety began equipping patrol units with naloxone. Partners: Public Safety, Harborview Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Equip more Public Safety units and add library branches as kit pickup points.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Kits distributed rose to 395 with library branches added as pickup points, and about three in four Public Safety units now carry naloxone. Partners: Public Safety, Harborview Community Health Center, Coastal Behavioral Health.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Finish equipping every Public Safety unit, train library staff, and distribute kits at overdose awareness day events.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Distributed 640 naloxone kits and trained 190 residents, many at the overdose awareness day events. Every Public Safety unit now carries naloxone, and library staff completed training. Partners: Public Safety, Harborview Community Health Center, Coastal Behavioral Health.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Install two public naloxone cabinets in Dune Avenue and Bayfront and begin a monthly report of kits used.
